scope: Target-name lexical audit plus manual review of structural bodyless builtin declaration selection and shared vararg lowering; this lexical check alone does not prove all semantics.
array_factory_review: Pinned builtins package metadata supplies names. Candidate declaration selection checks vararg element/array/result types, flags, receiver absence and supported array representations; lowering returns the shared constructed vararg array. Renamed declaration fixture tests prevent name-based dispatch. Existing list/conversion fallback paths are retained and disclosed.
limitations: Lexical absence of target names is evidence against application-specific branching, not a proof of all reusable semantic behavior. Runtime/ABI/Kotlin-consumer/module suites supply behavior evidence.
